title: FlexMARL: Graph-Driven Rollout-Training Co-Design for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.09578v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite algorithm-level innovations for multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), the underlying infrastructure for large-scale MARL remains underexplored. Existing training frameworks primarily optimize for single-agent scenarios and fail to capture the graph-structured nature of MARL. This fundamental mismatch leads to three MARL-specific challenges: topology-induced rollout skew, critical path synchronization barriers, and dynamic training demand. To bridge this gap, we propose FlexMARL, a graph-driven rollout-training co-designed framework for large-scale LLM-based MARL. translated_title: FlexMARL：面向基于大语言模型的多智能体强化学习的图驱动训练-采样协同设计
translated_abstract: 尽管多智能体强化学习（MARL）在算法层面不断创新，但大规模MARL的底层基础设施仍未得到充分探索。现有的训练框架主要针对单智能体场景进行优化，未能捕捉MARL的图结构特性。这一根本性的不匹配导致了三个MARL特有的挑战：拓扑引起的采样倾斜、关键路径同步障碍以及动态训练需求。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了FlexMARL，一个面向大规模基于大语言模型MARL的图驱动训练-采样协同设计框架。FlexMARL引入了多智能体执行图（MEG），并将该中间表示具体化为MEG Store，它提供去中心化的多表存储，并作为系统组件的数据中枢。围绕MEG Store，Rollout Engine开发了具有分层负载均衡的依赖并行采样，从而降低了推理……
tldr: FlexMARL通过引入多智能体执行图（MEG）作为中间表示，并提出图驱动的训练-采样协同设计框架，解决了大规模基于LLM的多智能体强化学习中的采样倾斜、同步障碍和动态训练需求等系统性挑战。
en_tdlr: FlexMARL proposes a graph-driven rollout-training co-designed framework that introduces the Multi-agent Execution Graph (MEG) as an intermediate representation to address topology-induced rollout skew, critical path synchronization barriers, and dynamic training demands in large-scale LLM-based MARL.
